# kVadrum

> kVadrum is a lightweight dev lab for systems, prototyping, and controlled chaos. Part of KeMeK Network.

kVadrum works on agentic development, developer tools, systems, and infrastructure.
The working mode is prototype → harden → ship: minimal ceremony, maximum momentum.
kvadrum.com is currently a single-page placeholder; the fuller web presence is still to come.

The name is written **kVadrum**: lowercase "k", capital "V", one word.
Not "Kvadrum", "KVadrum" or "K-Vadrum".

## Links

- [kVadrum on GitHub](https://github.com/kvadrum): kVadrum's public repositories
- [KeMeK Network](https://kemek.network): the network kVadrum is part of
- [Contact](https://kemek.com/prime/contact/): get in touch
